description: Generate an llms.txt file (llmstxt.org format) for ANY website, no login needed. Reads the home page, robots.txt, the XML sitemap and a sample of key pages (pricing, about, docs, products…), then returns a ready-to-publish llms.txt: `# Site name`, a one-line summary, and `## Section` link lists with page descriptions. Also reports whether the site already serves a real /llms.txt. Takes a `url`. Built from the site's own titles and meta descriptions (no AI rewriting) — review before publishing at the site root as /llms.txt.

url.description: The website to generate an llms.txt for, e.g. https://example.com

name: generate_llms_txt
